decision: Adopt, keep unchanged, or reject the artifact-fact delivery-state classifier (delivered_complete / delivered_partial / suspect_undeclared) plus the 70%-budget MVD checkpoint as the refinement of the terminal 'succeeded' status.
alternatives: A0 baseline: binary status (succeeded | failed) as shipped, no refinement.
A1 trivial structural baseline: 'delivered_complete' iff result is a non-empty dict.
A2 artifact-fact classifier under test (backend/api/domain/delivery_state.py + payload-shape adapter).
A3 independent provenance oracle: platform-side provenance facts (branch/commits/report/reproduction present), used as a label cross-check and never as classifier input.
hypotheses: H1 (primary): A2 macro-F1 >= 0.90 against the 60-unit manual annotation of real succeeded missions.
H2: A2 weak-label (cheap artifact proxy) recall >= 0.85 and precision >= 0.90.
H3 (fail-closed): any result missing changed_files (or checks) is never labelled delivered_complete.
H4 (shadow safety): classification and 70% checkpoint are pure functions; shadow mode produces zero database writes; golden outputs identical byte-for-byte.
H5 (zero domain semantics): domain-term scan hits = 0 on all delivery-semantics modules and their tests.

outcome_metrics.primary: macro-F1 of A2 over the three delivery states vs manual labels (macro over states with support > 0)
secondary: per-class precision, recall, F1 and the 3x3 confusion matrix
A0 and A1 macro-F1 on the same 60 units (baseline contrast)
agreement (Cohen kappa) between manual labels and the A3 provenance oracle
state distribution over the 60 units and over the fetched succeeded population

unit_of_analysis: one tensor_dev_missions row with status='succeeded' and non-null result

annotation_rubric_manual.labeler: agent m7804 (single annotator, rubric v1 frozen before data inspection)
annotation_rubric_manual.delivered_complete: Implementation artifacts are named AND the verification evidence contains at least one concrete, machine-checkable statement (test count, PASS/FAIL list, exit code, numeric criterion) AND the unit's own completion claim is consistent with those artifacts.
annotation_rubric_manual.delivered_partial: Some artifacts exist (e.g. changed_files or checks) but a required element is absent or vacuous: evidence is boilerplate/unverifiable, or the report/summary element is missing while the mission claims success.
annotation_rubric_manual.suspect_undeclared: The unit claims success but carries no implementation artifact or no verification evidence at all, so completion is undeclared by facts.
annotation_rubric_manual.tie_break: If borderline between complete and partial, choose delivered_partial (conservative against false completeness).

sampling_plan.population: tensor_dev_missions where status='succeeded' and result is a non-null object, fetched page-wise (200/page, up to 5 pages) through the authenticated platform API
sampling_plan.strata: changed_files bucket {0, 1-2, 3+} x checks-text length bucket {empty, short<60, medium<400, long}
sampling_plan.split_design: disjoint: 30-unit calibration split (contract discovery ONLY: payload shape, no threshold tuning) and 60-unit evaluation split (frozen classifier, measured once)
sampling_plan.repetition_rationale: Deterministic functions + fixed corpus => no run-to-run variance, so repetitions are not used for the primary metric. Sampling variability is reported as the 95% Wilson interval of accuracy on n=60.
sampling_plan.stopping_rule: Single evaluation run with the frozen artifacts. If macro-F1 < 0.90 the result is reported as honest FAIL; no threshold edits, no corpus edits, no re-runs after inspection.

confounders_and_limits: Single annotator (no inter-annotator kappa); mitigated by a published rubric, a provenance-oracle cross-check, and honest FAIL reporting.
Only succeeded missions are sampled, so the population-level estimate covers false completeness, not false failure detection.

Label leakage risk: the manual rubric shares the notion of 'artifact exists' with A2; the rubric additionally requires machine-checkable evidence content, which A2 cannot see, so exact agreement is not structurally guaranteed.
Mission records come from one platform instance (no cross-instance generalisation claim).
analysis_plan: Aggregate with a fixed confusion-matrix routine; accuracy with 95% Wilson interval; no outlier removal; missing labels reported, never imputed; every number in the report is emitted by evaluate.py into metrics.json (no hand transcription).
safety_and_resources: Read-only API access, no DB writes during evaluation, classification is in-process, shadow mode has no side effects; computation is minutes on one node, no cluster use needed.
